Evidence and revision

Labels: code-confirmed by source inspection unless a card says otherwise. Line style says how much this plot traces: solid is traced and reachable in the deployed service; dashed is traced but runs only with a test substitute; dotted is allowed by the source and has no traced sequence. Tests named in the inspector were located, not run, unless the inspector says otherwise. The build checks that every cited file exists and every cited symbol still appears in it; that proves the citations are current, not that the behaviour is.
